device_qa: D and E identity fidelity at actual companion size
no clipping or blur in portrait/landscape and compact contexts
no arms/hands/legs/feet appear in any state

SPEAK ends on completion, stop, interruption or TTS error
transcript and learning loop remain usable when audio fails
D/E selection changes identity only, not learning state
Reduced Motion removes continuous/local animation as intended

blink overlay looks natural on both D and E; otherwise disable/defer rather than open a heavy rig
frame smoothness and input responsiveness are acceptable
next_if_mouth_or_blink_visual_fail: repair or disable only failing local effect; open layered rig only if a real learning/visual need remains

preview.lifetime: approximately 110 minutes while the GitHub Actions keep-alive job remains running
preview.native_boundary: Web preview is the default visual/flow QA surface. Native builds remain required for platform-only TTS/audio lifecycle, signing, native performance and final production-device validation.
